title: Boss Entity Directory (bosses/<id>/data.json)
description: Schema for authored Boss archetypes per the Project Halcyon design doc. Bosses tier 1-5: T1 early Void-Touched, T2 faction-political Sundered Champions, T3 Regional Wall-of-Flesh (~1 per major biome), T4 Faction-defining, T5 cosmic Endgame. Each archetype admits multiple Resolution Paths (combat, negotiation, cosmological puzzle, bargained-into-priesthood). Defeating a Tier 3+ boss permanently changes regional world state and grants a chooseable Boss-Defeat Enhancement.

tier.description: Boss Tier. 1: Early Void-Touched. 2: Faction-political. 3: Regional Wall-of-Flesh. 4: Faction-defining. 5: Cosmic Endgame.

archetype_role.description: Conceptual role this archetype fills (e.g., 'sundered_hold', 'veiled_sleeper', 'quietist_avatar', 'void_predator', 'corrupted_tesla_relic'). Used by world-gen to ensure tier-appropriate variety per playthrough.

biome_affinity.description: Biomes where this boss is plausibly placed at world gen. Empty means biome-agnostic (T4+ bosses often span biomes).

macro_faction_affinity.description: Macro Factions whose territory or domain this boss intersects. Used for Resolution Path impact (defeating a Sundered Veranthi Court Sorcerer changes Veranthi relations).

combat_profile.description: Combat statistics if combat is one of the Resolution Paths. Optional for non-combat-only bosses (the Unblinking Eye archetype, certain Tier 4 negotiation-only encounters).

resolution_paths.description: Per the design doc, each boss admits multiple Resolution Paths. Not every boss is killable. Some are changeable, not destroyable (the Veiled Sleeper archetype is the canonical example).

path_type.description: combat: defeat in fight. negotiation: dialogue + reputation thresholds. cosmological_puzzle: use specific artifact or perform counter-ritual. bargain: become its priest or accept its terms. ritual: separate from puzzle, structured group ritual on-site.

prerequisites.description: Free-form precondition descriptors (artifact possession, faction standing, Drift band, etc.). The Storyteller and quest system validate these at engagement time.

outcome_world_state_changes.description: Permanent regional world-state changes triggered by this resolution path. Different paths produce different outcomes (combat-defeating the Veiled Sleeper may not be possible; bargaining with it makes the player a serpent-priest).

biome_clear_effect.description: Tier 3+ bosses cleanse or otherwise transform their biome on defeat (per the design doc). E.g., 'lowers Sundering rate in karnish_pine_forest by 80% for the playthrough', 'opens new resource node X in sethrai_river_delta'.

defeat_enhancement_options.description: Tier 3+ bosses grant a chooseable Boss-Defeat Enhancement. Player picks one of several rewards per defeated boss. Like Valheim's Forsaken Powers but with multiple-choice rather than fixed.

scene.description: Scene URN for the boss encounter (terrain, ambient cosmology, set dressing).
